snippet.title: Plangman: the word-guessing platformer (v2.6.7 trailer)
snippet.description:
Plangman (https://plangman.com) is an Apple II-inspired hangman platformer. In it, you take on the role of a space pilot trapped in a dungeon of forgotten memories. Each word you guess is a part of your forgotten backstory, and the letters are also blocks that can be used to solve physics puzzles.

Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/740690/Plangman/

itch.io:
https://vonlehecreative.itch.io/plangman
